string.text: A first-generation TASER Axon Body chest camera (#73002) with a wide-angle lens, a top-right mechanical power slider and a pre-RapidLock holster mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery (about 75% of an Axon Body 4 runtime, ~3.0 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A rugged second-generation Axon Body 2 chest camera (#74001) with a rubberized bumper shell, a side power switch, a RapidLock rear mount and a yellow Delta event button. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery (about 88% of an Axon Body 4 runtime, ~3.5 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A third-generation Axon Body 3 chest camera with an octagonal armored housing, a top monochrome status LCD, four microphones and a RapidLock mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery (about 95% of an Axon Body 4 runtime, ~3.8 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fourth-generation Axon Body 4 chest camera with a wide-angle lens, top status display, time-stamped overlay and friend-or-foe tag display. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery (100% baseline runtime, 4.0 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fifth-generation Axon Body 5 Pro chest camera with a recessed sapphire-shielded wide-angle lens, high-visibility top OLED display, dual programmable side buttons and high-efficiency electronics. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.\n\nRuns on a standard battery (+20% extended endurance over Axon Body 4, ~4.8 h at default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

Baseline full-battery recording time for Axon Body 4, in real-time hours (Gen 1 ~75%, Body 2 ~88%, Body 3 ~95%, Body 5 Pro 120%). Also scaled by the difficulty battery consumption setting, and the highest-charge / newest-generation camera is selected automatically.

Play a first-person animation when the battery dies (take the camera off, look at it, put it away) and when you put a new battery on it (slide the battery in, clip the camera back on). Off: the camera just turns off and on.
